title: Axeable Lacugrove Bookshelf
description: Make Lacugrove Bookshelf from the BetterEnd mod Axeable (as it should be)!
body:
This Data Pack adds the "mineable/axe" tag to the Lacugrove Bookshelf block added by the BetterEnd mod by quiqueck.

Link to original mod: https://modrinth.com/mod/betterend
